# Birds of War

Birds of War is a 2026 documentary film directed and written by Janay Boulos and Abd Alkader Habak, and produced by Sonja Henrici, Boulos, and Habak. It premiered in the World Cinema Documentary Competition at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival, where it won the Special Jury Award for Journalistic Impact.
Premise
The film follows the love story of Boulos, a London-based Lebanese journalist and Habak, a Syrian activist and cameraman, who met in 2016, when she was a BBC journalist seeking footage and he was a freelance cameraman in Aleppo during the Syrian civil war. The film is composed of 13 years of their personal archives spanning revolutions, war, and exile.
Release
Birds of War premiered at the World Cinema Documentary Competition at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival. It was available online for public viewing during the festival's at-home program (January 29 to February 1, 2026). In March 2026, it was screened at the Thessaloniki International Documentary Festival.
In December 2025, Dogwoof acquired the sales rights for Birds of War.
Awards
Birds of War won the Special Jury Award for Journalistic Impact at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival where it has its World premiere.
Following its European premiere at the 2026 Thessaloniki International Documentary Film Festival, Birds of War won four awards: the Silver Alexander in the International Competition, the [https://fipresci.org/festival/thessaloniki-doc-2026/ FIPRESCI] Award for Best Feature Documentary, the Human Rights in Motion Award by the [https://pace.coe.int/en/news/10219/sixth-pace-human-rights-in-motion-award-goes-to-birds-of-war-by-janay-boulos-and-abd-alkader-habak Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe (PACE)] and the [https://wift.gr/about/women-in-film-and-television-greece/?lang=en Women in Film and TV (WIFT GR)] Award for a Female Contribution Behind or in Front of the Camera.
The Audience Award at 57th edition of Visions du Réel also went to Birds of War by Janay Boulos and Abd Alkader Habak which was in the [https://variety.com/2026/film/global/visions-du-reel-from-dawn-to-dawn-1236729896/ Wide Angle competition]
